about: Shop placement audit (ORDERS item 16). For every game sign (MAP.pois index qi): truth = OSM surveyed point or verified address geocode, carried to the facade (tf: building b, edge e, t, facade point fx/fz); delta = game facade point -> truth facade point (m); flags; action for the map pipeline. missing[] = real businesses (OSM named shops, verified census addresses) without a game sign, with their truth facade.
